name: Savera Wood Floor Refinishing
sub: Sanding, UV-cured finishes, stain, repairs and recoats

hero.alt: Kendall Harrington of Savera's Hardwood Floor Restoration with his Bona sander and dust-containment vacuum

maps: Savera Hardwood Floor Restoration, 248 NY-25A, East Setauket, NY 11733

intro.text: Savera is a veteran-owned hardwood floor company based right here in East Setauket since 2019. Owner Kendall Harrington and his crew sand with dust containment and finish with Bona and instant-curing UV technology, so floors look great and your family gets back on them fast. Need just a refresh? They'll tell you honestly when a screen and recoat will do instead of a full sanding.

faq: How soon can we walk on the floors?
With UV-cured finishes, floors cure instantly with low odor. Ask Kendall which finish fits your home.
Do I need a full sanding?
Not always. Savera offers a screen and recoat when your floors just need a refresh.
Do they work on older homes?
Yes. They sand and restore historic and older floors.
Often, yes, depending on the wear layer. Kendall can look at your floors and tell you what's possible.
Can you fix pet stains and water damage?
Yes. Savera repairs and replaces damaged boards, then blends them in with the rest of the floor.
